title: Sorting by Type and Line No. in Sales and Purchase Postings
summary: In Business Central 2025 Wave 2, a new sorting order for sales and purchase postings by Type and Line No. replaces the legacy Line No.-only sorting to reduce deadlocks in high-concurrency scenarios. This change improves performance but may require refactoring existing Per Tenant Extensions that depend on the old sorting order.
key_points: Legacy posting sorted by Line No. only, causing deadlocks with heavy concurrency due to inconsistent resource locking order
Business Central 2025 Wave 2 introduces sorting by Type and Line No. when the feature flag is enabled
The new sorting order processes lines by type (G/L Account, Item, Resource, etc.) then by Line No., improving concurrent posting
Per Tenant Extensions relying on old Line No. ordering must be refactored and tested before upgrading
The feature can be disabled via Feature Management to fall back to legacy posting if needed
features: Multiple users posting item ledger entries simultaneously
